verdict.rationale: Kong documents per-request cost calculation that matches provider billing and frames it as the basis for "budget enforcement, per-consumer spend limits, and chargeback" (docs-18, docs-33). It also ships an AI Rate Limiting Advanced plugin and supports tracking costs across teams with enforced rate limits (docs-12, docs-21). However, the evidence never shows how to configure a hard spend budget; the AI rate-limiting plugin appears only by title, with no detail on whether it enforces dollar or token caps. Missing for 10: explicit configuration docs for hard spend/budget caps, per-key/team/user scoping details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
